jobs.title: AFMS SSC Medical Officer 2026: 120 Medical Officer Posts
jobs.summary: Armed Forces Medical Services has notified 120 Short Service Commission Medical Officer posts (90 men, 30 women) for MBBS and PG doctors. Apply online from 9 to 18 November 2026.
lines: Eligibility: MBBS (minimum); PG degree holders also eligible
Age: MBBS below 30 (born on or after 02-01-1997), PG below 35 (born on or after 02-01-1992), as on 31 Dec 2026
Selection: online application, shortlisting, interview at Delhi (tentatively Dec 2026), document check, medical

jobs.title: IOCL Barauni Refinery Apprentice 2026: 272 Trade & Technician Apprentice Seats
jobs.summary: Indian Oil's Barauni Refinery (Advt BR/HR/APPR/2026-27/II) is engaging 272 apprentices, 228 of them for B.Sc graduates and 44 for diploma holders. Apply by 6 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: 3-yr B.Sc with Maths/Physics/Chemistry/Industrial Chemistry (Trade Apprentice, 228 seats) or 3-yr diploma in Mechanical/Instrumentation (44 seats); min 50% (45% SC/ST/PwBD)
Age: 18-24 years as on 30-11-2026; SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, PwBD 10 years relaxation
Selection: merit on qualifying-exam %, document verification, medical
Dates: apply 6 Nov – 6 Dec 2026 on NAPS (B.Sc) / NATS (diploma) plus the IOCL form

jobs.title: CCS HAU Hisar Assistant Professor 2026: 26 Posts (Advt 3/2026)
jobs.summary: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University, Hisar has advertised 26 Assistant Professor posts in 24 disciplines (Advt No. 3/2026). Apply online by 7 December 2026 and send the hard copy by 14 December.
lines: Eligibility: Master's with 55% in the discipline + NET/SLET/SET, or Ph.D as per UGC rules; Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric
Fee: Rs 1,200 (General); Rs 300 Haryana reserved categories; PwD/ESM of Haryana exempt
Dates: apply online 7 Nov – 7 Dec 2026; hard copy by 14 Dec 2026
